actual_scope: For six sources over F2^6, exhaust the normalized closed 12-call source paths with eleven weight-one transitions and one charged weight-three closing TRIO; determine whether the 12 distinct prefix vertices cover all 63 nonzero pairwise differences.
scope_change_reason: The selected card asks for one priced alphabet extension on a small instance. bottleneck_link: A positive path would lower the six-source connector bill from 140 o + 142 p to 138 o + 140 p before any TRIO surcharge. The exact census excludes only this profile; it creates no concrete supplier or kappa change.
optimistic_fully_charged_cost: Both schedules require 126 output readouts. PR #2128 costs 140 o + 142 p including readouts. The tested profile would cost 138 o + 140 p, with the TRIO charged as o + 3p. Any extra TRIO surcharge tau must be less than 2o + 2p. No path in the tested profile exists.
method: Normalize q0=0, rotate the unique weight-three edge to the closing edge, and use coordinate permutations to set q1=1,q2=3. Enumerate every simple 12-vertex unit path from that prefix whose final vertex has weight three; compute exact pairwise XOR coverage.
domain: All normalized self-avoiding walks with 11 singleton edges and a closing weight-three edge on F2^6. The complete DFS has 1,098,204 simple walks, of which 709,812 have eligible closing endpoint; the independent checker scans the full 6^9 suffix product.
